fields.summary: Partner booking API — authenticate, create, amend and cancel bookings

content.text: Travel partners integrate with our booking service over HTTP. This story defines the partner-facing contract. There is no UI: partners call the API directly. Errors must be predictable, because partner systems retry and reconcile automatically.
, I want to obtain a token and manage bookings, so that I can sell rooms on my own channel.
, I want invalid bookings rejected at the door, so that we never store bookings we cannot honour.
